# Round A, batch 2, 26 October 2026, on arch (Linux builds) and GitHub windows-2022 (Windows builds)
# Lab outside the repositories; the SDKs installed this morning are reused through a symlink.
mkdir -p /private/tmp/nupkg-batch2
ln -sfn /private/tmp/nupkg-release-only/sdk /private/tmp/nupkg-batch2/sdk
cd ~/Dev/Speciale2026/dependencies/experiments/nupkg
nohup python3 -I run-batch.py 2026-10-26-nupkg-release-only-batch2 recipes/release-only/batch-third-party.txt /private/tmp/nupkg-batch2 > /private/tmp/nupkg-batch2/console.log 2>&1 &

# Run 1 was stopped at 13:20 (script errors, see the note); its text outputs moved to run1/. Run 2, 13:27, same command after clearing the lab:
rm -rf /private/tmp/nupkg-batch2/derive /private/tmp/nupkg-batch2/build /private/tmp/nupkg-batch2/gh
nohup python3 -I run-batch.py 2026-10-26-nupkg-release-only-batch2 recipes/release-only/batch-third-party.txt /private/tmp/nupkg-batch2 > /private/tmp/nupkg-batch2/console.log 2>&1 &

# After run 2 (13:41): three runs the script had not found by id (queued runs carry no run-name yet) were
# downloaded and classified by hand with the same functions; YamlDotNet's run failed on a nuget.org download
# (NETStandard.Library 2.0.3 "multiple attempts to download the nupkg have failed") and was dispatched once more:
gh workflow run nupkg-rebuild.yml -R peterjuulm/Speciale2026 -f recipe=release-only/2026-10-26-nupkg-release-only-batch2/yamldotnet.toml -f runner=windows-2022
